basic_info.description: This Unique property is in a prime location on one of the largest lots in the coveted St. Mary's Park neighborhood of Bernal Heights.   The flexible floor plan features a living room with hardwood floors and fireplace, 2 bedrooms, a formal dining room that has been used as 3rd bedroom, a bathroom, and a large updated kitchen with breakfast area that overlooks the yard with an IN GROUND POOL. There is also a large hot tub on the deck overlooking the pool. The garage can easily accommodate 2 cars and provides for expansion potential. There is deferred maintenance but potential galore.
